meta.title: Launch a token on fly.ai
meta.description: Launch a token on Robinhood Chain. It trades on a bonding curve, then graduates into its own FLYAI pool with locked liquidity.

head.title: Launch a token
head.lede: It trades on a bonding curve from your first minute. When the curve sells out, it graduates into its own FLYAI pool with locked liquidity.

form.name: Name
form.logoHelp: A link to a square image. It's saved on chain and can't be changed later.
form.taxHelp: Taken on every trade on the curve and paid to you. It stops at graduation and can't be changed.
form.devHelp: Up to ${max} ({pct}% of the supply). Held for you until graduation.
form.devGets: You get about {tokens} tokens ({pct}% of the supply), held for you until graduation.

rules.title: The rules
rules.supply: 1 billion tokens: 800M on the curve, 200M for the pool at graduation. Nobody can mint more.
rules.open: Trading opens {secs} seconds after you launch. A sniping tax starts at {snipe}% and falls to 0 over {mins} minutes.
rules.limit: For the first {mins} minutes a wallet can hold at most {pct}% of the supply and buy once per block.
rules.trade: {fee}% fee on each trade: 70% to you, 20% to fly.ai, 10% to activated Trader Flies.
rules.grad: At {target} raised, the raise converts to FLYAI automatically and the token moves to its own FLYAI pool. The liquidity is locked for good.
rules.dev: Your own first buy is held until graduation, so you can't sell it on the curve.

problem.name: Give it a name of up to 32 characters, with no spaces at the start or end.
problem.symbol: The symbol is 1 to 10 capital letters or numbers.
problem.reserved: That name belongs to fly.ai's own token. Pick another.
problem.logo: The logo link must start with https:// or ipfs://.
problem.tax: The creator tax can be 2% at most.
problem.dev: That first buy isn't a number.
problem.devMax: That first buy is over the limit.
problem.eth: Your wallet doesn't have enough ETH for the fee.
problem.usdg: Your wallet doesn't have enough USDG for that first buy.

msg.confirm: Confirm step {n} of {of} in your wallet…
msg.noToken: It went through, but we couldn't read the token's address. Check the transaction in your wallet.
msg.noWallet: No wallet found in this browser.
